about: BootStick's download list. The app ships this file and replaces it with a newer copy (higher version) from https://aasim.site/apps/bootstick/catalog.json. Without a pattern, url is the file itself. With one, url is a page or folder and the newest match of pattern in it is used, after first stepping into the newest folder matching dir (then sub) when set.
